name: turn-receipt
description: Prints a receipt beneath each answer: the turn's tokens and cost in US dollars, its subagents' share, and the session's running total. Keeps a monthly tally apart from the short-lived session records; /receipt-month shows it.

session.title: Session total
session.description: Also show the session's running total beside each turn: turns receipted, tokens summed and dollars.

agents.title: Subagent line
agents.description: Add a line for the subagent runs the turn made: runs, tokens and dollars. Off, their cost is folded into the turn's figure.

saveEvery.title: Save every N turns
saveEvery.description: How many turns pass between saves of the session's total. 0 saves only at session end and on the commands.

keepDays.title: Keep session records for N days
keepDays.description: How long saved session records are kept before they are dropped at session start. The monthly tallies are kept apart, for 12 months.

allowEmptyReceipts.title: Allow empty receipts
allowEmptyReceipts.description: Also print a receipt, and count the turn, when the turn reported no usage and moved no ledger: an interrupt before any response, an API error. Its token counts read 0. Off, such a turn gets no receipt and is not counted.
